articles.title: California judge orders one former partner to pay the other $66,192 in legal fees after house dispute
articles.summary: Matthew Shroder and Mackenzie Fotsch are currently embroiled in legal disputes regarding a jointly owned property in Sausalito. After achieving a partial victory in a motion to strike, Shroder sought $90,010 in attorney fees and the court awarded him $66,192.50.

articles.title: Meet Hazmatt: Oklahoma’s 20-foot reclining robot made from discarded dumpsters, built for just over $14,000
articles.summary: Norman, Oklahoma has unveiled a captivating new public sculpture named Hazmatt, crafted from recycled dumpsters. This striking giant robot, funded by surplus construction funds totaling slightly over $14,000, is strategically located at the city’s Household Hazardous Waste Facility.

articles.title: Judge Judy’s mentoring programme marks 20 years, reaching 1,500 young women
articles.summary: Her Honor Mentoring began with a modest gathering of girls two decades ago and has since flourished remarkably. This program matches high school seniors with dedicated mentors, guiding them through educational and career paths.

articles.title: Reddit Fights Teen Account Ban: Platforms contest Australia’s under-16 law; ruling may sway global curbs
articles.summary: In late 2025, Australia enacted a law prohibiting individuals under 16 from accessing social media. However, Reddit and a libertarian organization are contesting this legislation in the High Court.

articles.title: TGPSC AEE hall ticket 2026 released for Civil, Electrical exams; live photo mandatory, download link closes November 5: Check direct link to download here
articles.summary: The Telangana Public Service Commission has issued the TGPSC AEE Hall Ticket 2026 for Civil and Electrical recruitment examinations scheduled for November 6 and 7. Registered candidates can access their admit cards online until November 5, 11:59 PM.

articles.title: CAT admit card 2026: IIM Indore to release hall tickets tomorrow, check hall ticket download steps
articles.summary: IIM Indore is scheduled to release the CAT 2026 admit card on November 4. Registered candidates will be able to download their hall tickets from iimcat.ac.in using their user ID and password.

articles.title: Indian Coast Guard recruitment 2026: Offline applications close today for Foreman of Stores posts
articles.summary: Indian Coast Guard recruitment 2026: The Indian Coast Guard will close offline applications for Foreman of Stores recruitment 2026 on November 3. The recruitment covers four Group B, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial vacancies under the Ministry of Defence.

articles.title: BPSC Bihar TRE 4.0 recruitment 2026: Application deadline today for 32,388 teacher posts; apply here
articles.summary: BPSC TRE 4.0 recruitment 2026: The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) will close the online application process for TRE 4.0 recruitment on November 3, 2026. The recruitment initially covers 32,388 teaching vacancies across primary, middle, secondary and senior secondary schools.

articles.title: Paris Jackson is demanding that her father’s estate pay alleged dues worth USD 600 million
articles.summary: Paris Jackson has filed a court case demanding USD 600 million from her father's estate over inheritance delays. She accuses the executors of blocking her and her siblings from receiving their rightful shares.

articles.title: Meghan Markle’s father admitted to Florida dementia care facility amid ongoing investigation
articles.summary: Thomas Markle Sr., estranged father of Meghan Markle, has entered a care facility for dementia treatment. He moved back to America after living in the Philippines for several years.

articles.title: Suriya says 'The One' is not just his title but collective identity
articles.summary: Suriya shared the meaning of his title 'The One' during the audio launch of his film. He emphasized that this title reflects the unity between him and his fans.

articles.title: 'Fahadh should hear this': Nazriya Nazim's funny reaction
articles.summary: In a much-anticipated comeback, Nazriya Nazim returns to Tamil cinema after a 12-year hiatus with her film 'Scene.' At a recent promotional event, she expressed heartfelt appreciation for the love and support from her fans in Chennai. Her collaboration with Suriya amplifies her excitement, while the involvement of a talented Malayali cast and crew adds a meaningful touch.
